segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Thanks for coming. The goal today is to decide whether the new analytics add-on goes into the Pro plan or stays separate.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Usage data says about forty percent of Pro customers would use it weekly.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Sales would love it bundled. It's an easier conversation than an upsell.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: But bundling means we can't price it separately later without a backlash.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Right. What did the customer interviews say?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Mixed. Larger accounts want it, smaller accounts said they'd never touch it.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: The real issue is unit economics. Our gross margin on Pro is sixty-one percent right now, and the add-on's infrastructure cost would drag it to about fifty-two if we bundle.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: And on the enterprise tier we're already discounting so hard that the margin on the top ten accounts is under forty. Finance won't sign off on anything that touches that.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Plus the support team's salaries are coming out of the same cost center, and we just gave them eleven percent raises.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay. So a separate add-on with a trial inside Pro might be the middle ground.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: A thirty-day trial would let sales show it without committing.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: I like that. It keeps our options open.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Marketing suggested Insights. I'd prefer something more specific.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Usage Analytics is boring, but nobody will be confused.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's test both names in the next customer survey.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: I'll draft the survey this week.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Great. Let's reconvene in two weeks with the survey results.

planted.quote: Our gross margin on Pro is sixty-one percent right now
